originality.rationale: FAIL originality by direct prior implication rather than inaccessible-literature speculation. Xu Proposition 3.3 already gives S_d exactly through vertex shriek degrees for ANY stratified variety, and Example 3.4 performs the same depth-three calculation at n=3; Juteau’s published type-A table gives H¹(U_n)=0, H²(U_n)=C for ALL n≥3. Substitution gives S3 not S4 for every n without a new lemma. Xu Proposition 3.5 then classifies S2 sheaves as pushforwards of local systems, and the standard simply connected cotangent-bundle sphere model makes them constant, yielding the zero MCM conclusion automatically. No independent new mathematical ingredient survives this exact implication comparison.
residual_risks: The literature has an apparent degree-index typo in Xu Example 3.4 (its written H³(U) relation), but the relevant H²(U) from Juteau and the cone localization yielding H³(i^!) are valid; that typo does not create a new original family theorem.
No conclusion claimed for other Lie types or refined stratifications.
